Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using HTML redirectors in email attachments to deliver malicious Excel documents with macros that drop payloads
Malware downloaders delivering banking Trojans and ransomware strains
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with HTML attachments that redirect to download malicious macro-laden Excel files
Large-sized malicious spam campaigns driven by the Necurs botnet
Indicators of Compromise: SHA-256 hashes of malware samples provided by Microsoft Security Intelligence
Use of IP traceback service to track IP addresses of machines downloading malicious Excel files
